extension.description: A multi-repository Git client in the style of the JetBrains (WebStorm) Git Log: one merged log across every repository in your workspace, with branches, commit details, changed files and native diffs, and fetch, pull, checkout, merge and rebase across repositories.

setting.linyra.maxConcurrency.descriptio: Maximum number of git processes running at once.
setting.linyra.scanDepth.markdownDescrip: Folder levels to search the workspace folders for repositories. Linyra shows these together with the repositories the Git extension has open. See also `#git.repositoryScanMaxDepth#`.
setting.linyra.excludeRepos.description: Glob patterns for repositories to leave out, matched against the repository folder name and its full path.
setting.linyra.profiles.markdownDescript: Named groups of repositories for the Repo List, e.g. `{ "backend": ["acme-api", "acme-libs"] }`. Each repository is its path relative to the workspace folder (`.` for the folder itself; in a multi-root workspace, the folder's name first). Saved from the Repo List; clicking a profile ticks its repositories and changes no other filter.
setting.linyra.blame.markdownDescription: Show who last changed the cursor's line in Linyra's diffs and revisions, as of the commit shown. The text follows `#git.blame.editorDecoration.template#`.

setting.linyra.avatars.markdownDescripti: Author pictures in the Log, in place of initials. `remote` asks only the servers a repository's own remotes name: a GitLab instance's avatar API, and GitHub for its noreply addresses. Pictures are asked only for the rows on screen and kept in memory until the window reloads. A workspace's settings can turn avatars off, never ask more servers. Self-hosted servers: `#linyra.avatarHosts#`; a service of your own: `#linyra.avatarUrlTemplate#`.
setting.linyra.avatars.off: No pictures: authors show their initials, and no server is asked.
setting.linyra.avatars.remote: Ask only the repository's own remote hosts (GitLab, GitHub).
setting.linyra.avatars.remoteGravatar: Ask the remote hosts, then Gravatar for the authors they have no picture of.
setting.linyra.avatarHosts.markdownDescr: What kind of server a self-hosted remote is, for author pictures: `{ "git.acme.test": "gitlab" }`. github.com, gitlab.com and hosts named `gitlab.*` or `github.*` are recognized without it. Other servers are asked nothing.
setting.linyra.avatarUrlTemplate.markdow: An avatar service of your own, asked after the remote hosts: `https://avatars.acme.test/{md5}?s={size}`. Placeholders: `{md5}` and `{sha256}` of the trimmed, lowercased email, `{email}`, `{size}`. It must name the author. Empty: none. Only your user settings can set it.

setting.linyra.ai.enabled.markdownDescri: Turns on Linyra's AI features. While this is off, nothing is sent to any AI provider. Set up a provider, a model and an API key with **Linyra: Configure AI…**.
setting.linyra.ai.profiles.markdownDescr:
Saved AI connections, written by **Linyra: Configure AI…** and **Linyra: Switch AI Model…**: `protocol` (`openai` for OpenAI and every OpenAI-compatible server such as Ollama or LM Studio, `anthropic`, `gemini`), `baseUrl`, `model` and `effort` (the thinking level; `default` sends none). API keys are never stored here: they are in VS Code's secret storage, each bound to the address it was entered for.

With the `anthropic` protocol on `https://api.anthropic.com`, requests to `claude-fable-5-1`, `claude-opus-5-5`, `claude-opus-5` and `claude-sonnet-5-5` opt into server-side fallback (`fallbacks: "default"`): when the model declines a request for policy reasons, Anthropic answers it with its recommended fallback model. Requests to any other address never use fallback.
setting.linyra.ai.activeProfile.markdown: The `id` of the AI profile in use (see `#linyra.ai.profiles#`). **Linyra: Switch AI Model…** sets it.
setting.linyra.ai.exclude.markdownDescri: Files the AI prompts leave out, as globs matched against repository-relative paths: `name` and `*.ext` match at any depth, `dir/` matches a folder at any depth, a pattern containing `/` matches from the repository root, `**` matches any number of folders. The defaults leave out lockfiles, minified and built files, `node_modules`, and secrets (`.env*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`).
setting.linyra.ai.maxPromptTokens.markdo: Ask before sending a request estimated above this many tokens (characters ÷ 4). `0` never asks.
